description.value: Tama Supermarket is a family-owned neighbourhood grocery store founded in 2017, taking its name from the founders' surnames Tabon and Martinez. Specializing in Filipino and Asian groceries — stocking brands like Mama Sita's, Datu Puti, and Lucky Me! alongside fresh produce, frozen goods, and body care imports — it functions as a cultural food hub on the Kingsway corridor. Cyclists passing through can resupply with a wide range of pantry staples, fresh fruit and vegetables, snacks, and beverages.
